title: 3 Father Mcsweeney Terrace, Ardbrack, Kinsale, Co. Cork, P17EY97
seoTitle: 3 Father Mcsweeney Terrace, Ardbrack, Kinsale, Co. Cork, P17EY97
description:
Bowe Property present to the market a beautiful Kinsale home in one of the towns most sought after private locations, at the confluence of Scilly and Ardbrack overlooking the natural beauty of Kinsale Harbour, its forts, waterway and coastline. This original property has been tastefully and stylishly
renovated with significant emphasis on capturing the beauty and the view that is offered from every aspect of the extensive gardens and three tier outer decks flowing from the impressive kitchen/living area allowing one to cocoon within the closed environment on winter days and blend the outer decks
to the best of al fresco living on brighter warmer days. A beautiful bespoke bathroom on the first floor adjoins a master suite with dual aspect and framed windows to the rear overlooking the gardens and Kinsale Harbour and its moving waterways and pleasure marine traffic that is quite simply perfect and
naturally hypnotic. Potential to create a larger design and floor area to the rear of the property to further capture the beauty of its setting and outlook is obvious subject to good design and scale. The property has a host of high end specification features, but it is the setting and natural outlook of the property onto James Fort, Charles Fort, Kinsale Marina and The Dock that is the one constant through all seasons that is heavenly and inspiring. The property is located 18kms from Cork International Airport and within 1km of Kinsale town centre with all of its renowned amenities, cafes, restaurants, bars, golf clubs and lifestyle all on the doorstep of this most beautiful private home. Properties in such a location are very rare offerings and this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to acquire a property in one of Kinsales most special and loved locations.

Viewing is available and strictly by prior application.
                                                                                              ___________________________________________________________


Kitchen/Dining/Living Area-6.95m x 5.33m
Open plan area with sliding doors out to tiered deck with glass balustrade.
Fish-eye views of Kinsale Harbour entrance, Kinsale Marina, Castlepark
Marina, Charles Fort and James Fort.

Fully fitted with presses & cupboards. Integrated appliances include double
electric oven, dishwasher, hob with overhead stainless steel extractor and
fridge/freezer. Feature peninsula breakfast table. Sash windows onto front drive
and gardens incorporating a window seat. Two windows to rear overlooking
Kinsale Harbour with exquisite views. Sliding door onto deck area. Feature
insert stove with natural dry stone exposed chimney breast. Recessed lighting.
Laminate floor. Floor level socketing. Two Radiators. 

Landing- 2.3m x 1.1m
Window to rear overlooking gardens with exquisite views of Kinsale Harbour
entrance, Kinsale Marina, Castlepark Marina, Charles Fort and James Fort.


Bathroom- 3.67m x 2.3mFully fitted with premium sanitary ware including w.c., wash-hand basin with
oversized hand crafted vanity unit with extensive storage and oversized shower
with glazed pivot door. Sash window to front. Recessed lighting. Access to attic
hatch. Mechanical extractor. Heated towel radiator.


Bedroom-4.69m x 4.57m
Large picture frame windows onto rear gardens with exquisite views of Kinsale
Harbour entrance, Kinsale Marina, Castlepark Marina, Charles Fort and James
Fort. Two sash windows to front. Built in slide robe. T.V. point.


Garden Utility Room-1.3m x 1.25m
Plumbed for washing services. Storage.



Features:
· Upper deck automated awning.
· Outdoor power sockets.
· Deck area recessed lights.

Services: 
-Mains Services. 
-Oil fired central heating.
